host: Native collaboration; explicit supplied updated guidance and recorded built-tool feedback
scope: Assisted repair smoke on six existing failed drafts. Not held out, matched or causal improvement evidence.
stop: Stop after two repair batches and two independent reading batches, even if a repair fails. Do not tune source instructions during run.
acceptance: Check each draft with the built word-limit helper and full source/task review. Check every material condition independently; passing the length check cannot establish preservation. Fresh readers see only repaired drafts and atomic questions, not source/gold. Corrected controls use a requested posting day, not ambiguous deadline wording.
confounds: Guidance, numeric feedback, source omission feedback and additional effort all change together. Cannot attribute any repair to one factor or generalise beyond these known cases.
revisionUsageCost: Exact backend revision, tokens and costs not exposed; unknown
